On this small beans plot, I will keep costs low and use what I can manage with my family. I do not plan to buy chemical fertilizer for beans, because if I get any fertilizer it is usually for maize first, but I can put some manure or compost if I have enough. I will plant my usual local seed, depend on the rains, and do the weeding mostly with family labor. I do not expect to spray chemicals, and I will only hire labor if I get short at a busy time, but for this plot I think we can manage ourselves.
